source: eng_dataset.csv (crowd-labeled Twitter emotion dataset: anger, fear, joy, sadness)

source_mapping.fear: desperate (closest available proxy - both anxious/high-arousal-negative, not identical to how we defined desperate)

note: No source data exists for calm or proud - this dataset can only externally validate 4 of the 6 emotions. Sentences were filtered only for objective quality (length, no profanity, no heavy link/hashtag noise, deduped near-identical posts) and NOT hand-picked for how clearly they express the emotion, to keep this an unbiased external check rather than a cherry-picked one. Expect more noise than the hand-written stimuli.json set - that's real-world label noise, not a bug.
